notes: Twelve activation evals (five from 2026-09-17, seven added 2026-09-18): each one must fail its baseline arm and pass with the skill on — a scenario that passes in both arms is not evidence and is dropped, and a single check may pass in both as long as at least one fails. Separation is a property of the (scenario, model) pair, not of the scenario: name the model with `--model` or the run is not reproducible. Measured 2026-09-17: on the session's default model three of the five separate (`select-in-loop`, `authz-injection`, `hr-payroll-read`); `invented-api` missed its with-arm checks there and `broken-luw` passed both arms, and re-measured on `sonnet` both separate as intended. Adds to the 2026-09-18 group (`unbound-ref`, `itab-index-zero`, `lock-no-dequeue`, `formal-param-type`, `pd-relations-empty-on-error`, `sys-field-in-key`, `hr-write-customizing-read`): they cover the rules that carry no other scenario — a reference dump, an off-by-one index, a leaked enqueue, the formal-parameter type check, the PD relation read (the HR block's second half alongside `hr-payroll-read`), the system field in a persisted key, and the HR customizing read on the write path (`hr-pa.md:30` — the rule a live session on 2026-09-18 filed under the read side and skipped: a lone `SELECT SINGLE` with no loop in sight, so the buffer and the table key went missing). Measured 2026-09-18 with no `--model` (the session default): all seven pass with the skill on and fail the baseline — the separating checks are the level (`P1`/`P2`), the rule's slug or `file.md:line`, and for `lock-no-dequeue` the branch that leaks the lock; `hr-write-customizing-read` is the one scenario whose baseline misses every check. Dropped that day: `inline-hash-type`, a writing scenario for the corrected `#`-in-an-inline-declaration rule — measured in both arms it separated nothing (the baseline typed the target explicitly too), and its citation check failed the with-arm, so it scored the formulation, not the defect. Expect the citation check to be the flaky one in a writing scenario, where the artifact is code and not a report (same check in `invented-api`). The checks are deterministic regexes over the answer text — no judge model — so a run costs one call per arm. The queries name the skill on purpose: an unnamed query measures whether the model reaches for a skill, not whether this skill is any good. The baseline arm runs with an empty config directory and an empty HOME — with a real HOME the session finds the skill's files on disk through the user's CLAUDE.md and answers from them without ever loading the skill (the runner lives outside the skill folder). A P0/security scenario is included on purpose: `[P0]` is the band a review of ordinary code never reaches, so it is the one least likely to be produced without the rules (the P0 fixtures live in the skill's `evals/fixtures/`); `hr-payroll-read` covers the HR block, which is the largest part of the rule body and had no scenario of its own

evals.query: Напиши на ABAP 7.50 метод, который по дате приёма (begda) и дате увольнения (endda) считает стаж сотрудника в месяцах. Только код метода. Следуй скиллу abap-coding-standards.
expected_behavior: Uses a date utility that exists on the target release (cl_reca_date, cl_hrpad_date_computations or one of the standard FMs) instead of writing the month arithmetic by hand.
Does not call a generic ADD_MONTH_TO_DATE — the FM family is country-specific and only the country variants exist.
Does not use utclong, DATN or TIMN — those arrive after 7.50.
Says which release the recommendation belongs to, or names the assumption.

checks.label: no call to a generic ADD_MONTH_TO_DATE

Cites the finding by file and line.

evals.query: Отревью authz_injection.abap. Найди дефекты. Используй скилл abap-coding-standards.
expected_behavior: Rates the statement text built from the input (the dynamic WHERE over a selection-screen value) as P0 — SQL injection — or the CALL TRANSACTION with a variable transaction code WITHOUT AUTHORITY-CHECK as P0 — an authorization bypass; both are the skill's P0 band.
Names the rule that carries the defect: security.md:6 (no-sql-string-concat) and/or security.md:23 (no-authority-check-bypass).
Notices that the direct Open SQL read of pa0008 bypasses the automatic P_ORGIN check of HR_READ_INFOTYPE and that no AUTHORITY-CHECK covers the report.
Says the fix concretely: a host variable (@iv_pernr) with a constant statement text, and an explicit AUTHORITY-CHECK before the call.
Cites the finding by file and line.

evals.query: Отревью hr_payroll_read.abap. Найди дефекты. Используй скилл abap-coding-standards.
expected_behavior: Rates the hand IMPORT of the PCL2 cluster (ur) as P1 (hr-payroll.md, payroll-no-hand-cluster): the components are mapped by memory layout, so a country-structure change lands the values in the wrong components with no error, and the read skips the cluster-version/archive handling.

Flags the wage-type text read: a direct SELECT from t512t per row instead of the standard text FM HR_GET_LGART_TEXT / cl_hr_t512w, and inside the LOOP (P2, hr-payroll.md).
Cites the finding by file and line, and the rule by reference file and line (hr-payroll.md:8 / hr-payroll.md:11) — the artifact a session without the skill does not produce.

checks.label: rates the hand cluster read P1

evals.query: Отревью unbound_ref.abap. Найди дефекты. Только отчёт, без переписывания кода. Используй скилл abap-coding-standards.
expected_behavior: Rates the dereference of lo_manager as P1: the reference is filled only inside the IF, so with an empty iv_manager_pernr the next call dumps CX_SY_REF_IS_INITIAL — a crash, not "no manager".
Names the guard the fix needs (IS BOUND before the dereference, or a value in every path) rather than a reformatting of the IF.
Cites the finding by file and line and the rule by reference file and line (data.md:33, slug ref-unbound-check) — the artifact a session without the skill does not produce.
Does not spend the report on the WRITE statement or the missing pretty-printing.

evals.query: Отревью itab_index_zero.abap. Найди дефекты. Только отчёт, без переписывания кода. Используй скилл abap-coding-standards.
expected_behavior: Rates both the table expression lt_pernr[ 0 ] and READ TABLE ... INDEX 0 as P1: an ABAP table index is 1-based, so there is no such row — the table expression dumps, the READ returns sy-subrc <> 0 with an untouched target.
States the fix as indexing from 1 (or a different read that expresses the intent), not as a bounds check on the loop.
Cites the rule by reference file and line (itab.md:16, slug itab-index-1-based) and the finding by file and line.
Does not rate the SELECT or the lines( ) call as the defect.

evals.query: Отревью lock_no_dequeue.abap. Найди дефекты. Только отчёт, без переписывания кода. Используй скилл abap-coding-standards.
expected_behavior: Names the real defect: the lock survives the two early exits (raise_busy on a foreign lock, the RETURN on a failed check) — DEQUEUE runs only on the happy path, so the object stays locked for the session and the next write reports a foreign lock.
Says where the DEQUEUE belongs: every branch including CLEANUP / a TRY-CATCH, not just after the UPDATE.
Cites the rule (errors.md:21) and the finding by file and line.
Does not confuse the enqueue server lock with a database lock, and does not report the UPDATE statement form as the finding.

evals.query: Отревью formal_param_type.abap. Найди дефекты. Только отчёт, без переписывания кода. Используй скилл abap-coding-standards.
expected_behavior: Rates the call as P1 and names the reason: a formal parameter is checked for type compatibility, not convertibility — a string actual into iv_begda TYPE dats is a syntax error, not a silent conversion as it would be in an operand position.
Reads the type from the callee's declaration (the class definition in the same file), not from the call site — and checks both parameters, not just the first.
Names the fix: convert into a local of the target type at the call (or CONV dats( ... ) where the formal accepts it), or a generic character formal if the callers genuinely differ.
Cites the rule (signatures.md:22, slug formal-param-type-subset) and the finding by file and line.

checks.label: names a conversion at the call

evals.query: Отревью pd_relations_empty_on_error.abap. Найди дефекты. Только отчёт, без переписывания кода. Используй скилл abap-coding-standards.
expected_behavior: Rates the ignored is_ok as P1: on the object layer an empty relations table is "no relation" only with is_ok = abap_true — lv_ok is read and never used, so a failed read (an authorization denial arrives exactly this way) is taken for "no relation".
Names the consequence: the branch then creates the relation in a failure case, and the message list that carries the reason is discarded.
Names the fix: read is_ok and the message list, hand the failure up (RETURNING error object or own zcx_*), and only treat is_ok = abap_true with an empty table as "nothing there".
Cites the rule (hr-pd.md:11, slug pd-relations-empty-on-error) and the finding by file and line.

evals.query: Отревью sys_field_in_key.abap. Найди дефекты. Только отчёт, без переписывания кода. Используй скилл abap-coding-standards.
expected_behavior: Rates the journal key built from sy-sysid (and sy-datum) as P2: the key is persisted business data, and the system field is a different value in QA and PRD — the same business case gets a different key per landscape, and a comparison or a re-run silently differs.
Keeps the legitimate uses apart: sy-datum/sy-uname as a log column is not the defect; the defect is the system field inside the key.
Names the fix: a key from the input (pernr and a number range / the source message id), not from the executing system.
Cites the rule (data.md:22) and the finding by file and line.

checks.label: names the system field in the key

evals.query: Отревью hr_write_customizing_read.abap. Найди дефекты. Только отчёт, без переписывания кода. Используй скилл abap-coding-standards.
expected_behavior: Flags the hand-written customizing read — SELECT SINGLE from T500P — as P2 (hr-pa.md:30): HR customizing goes through the buffered cl_hr_t* family (one class per table, read( <key fields> )), here cl_hr_t500p=>read( persa )-molga — or cl_hrpa_molga=>read_molga_by_persa( ).

Does not excuse the read because it is not inside a LOOP: the rule is about the read, not the loop — a lone SELECT SINGLE and a read the write path needs are the same defect, and the class carries the buffer and the table key.

Flags the direct SELECT from pa0001 (hr-pa.md:9): PA master data is read through the class framework (cl_hrpa_masterdata_factory=>get_read_infotype( )->read_single( ... ) / if_hrpa_read_infotype), not a hand-written SELECT with hand-made begda/endda ranges.

Keeps the feature call itself out of the findings — cl_hrpa_feature=>get_value / HR_FEATURE_BACKFIELD with a PME01 is the sanctioned path (hr-pa.md:19); inventing another API for it is a false positive.
Cites the finding by file and line of the fixture, and the rule by reference file and line (hr-pa.md:30 / hr-pa.md:9).

checks.label: names the reader for the personnel area / country grouping
names the PA master-data read path
